title: A log-convex screen adds five failures at a 0.10 change limit in 607 selected Allen recovery curves
abstract: We tested a necessary log-convex condition for fixed-sign positive exponential recovery mixtures in Allen Synaptic Physiology r2.1. A triplet certificate added five exclusions to a prior signed divided-difference test at an assumed uniform error limit of 0.10 normalized units. The prior test excluded 477 of 607 curves; the combined screen excluded 482. A ten-trial minimum retained only 37 curves and gave no added exclusions at this limit. The screen does not solve full mixture feasibility. Error limits are assumed, not measured uncertainty. Shared recordings, selected slices, separate protocol trials and missing trial-level errors prevent a biological model rejection or population-rate claim. Code, proof, aggregate findings, figure and source hashes support reproduction. External records are not bundled.

display.caption: Prior and combined failure counts at assumed error limit 0.10 and added counts at three limits. Counts describe stored curves, not biological rejection rates.
